text:
Alex Kim: Morning — quick check: can we move the weekly triage from 11:00 -> 10:30 on Thu? APAC folks asked for an earlier slot. poll: http://doodle.example/abc :thinking_face:
Maria Gonzales: 10:30 works for me, gives us time before the design review. +1 for earlier slot
Tyler Chen: prefer 11 normally but can do 10:30 occasionally. what's the agenda change? are we condensing?
Alex Kim: agenda tweak: cut deep-dive to every other week, keep backlog quick-pass (5m), owners report (2m each), hotfix lane (5m). proposed bullets:
- quick backlog triage (10m)
- owner updates (10m)
- hotfix / unblock lane (5m)
- quick PR pings / blockers (5m)
Maria Gonzales: can we add 'rollout watch' as a 2m item? recent infra deploys caused a couple of alerts last week
Tyler Chen: sg. also propose rotating owner for 'hotfix lane' weekly so it's not always infra team
Oncall Bot: Reminder: Calendar invite exists for "Weekly Engineering Triage" at Thu 11:00. If time changes, update calendar and /pagerduty schedule if needed.
Alex Kim: I'll update calendar and PD alias if poll lands. Can someone volunteer to take next week's hotfix lane? @Tyler Chen? :pray: 
Tyler Chen: I can take next week. I'll swap if conflict appears.
Maria Gonzales: Thanks. Alex — after you update, drop the new invite and short agenda in #eng and ping the SIG leads.
Alex Kim: Will do. Poll closes EOD today. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
